identity.name: Brazilian Journal of Physical Therapy
identity.source_note: Live ScienceDirect guide was bot-blocked to WebFetch (HTTP 403); encoded from a headless render (Apify rag-web-browser) of the live page at https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/journal/14133555/publish/guide-for-authors which returned HTTP 200 current content.

encoding_notes: Case reports and case series are explicitly NOT accepted: 'We do not accept single case studies and series of cases (i.e. clinical trials without a comparison group).'
Short communications (1,200 words, up to 2 figures, 1 table, 10 references; max six/year) are accepted but have no clean enum slot; not encoded as an article_type.
Masterclass articles (invited, state-of-the-art) mapped to 'review'; regular 'reviews' + systematic reviews also covered.

Combined figures+tables cap = 5 total ('A total of five (5) combined tables and figures is allowed'); schema holds figures_max/tables_max separately so both left null with the combined cap noted here.
Manuscript word cap 3,500 words excludes title page, abstract, references, tables, figures and legends; applied to all encoded types (review/masterclass cap not separately stated).
Tiered figure DPI: 300 dpi color/grayscale halftones, 1000 dpi bitmapped line drawings, 500 dpi line/halftone combinations; encoded min_dpi=300 as the lowest stated floor.

Reference numeral placement: 'outside periods and commas, inside colons and semicolons' — encoded in_text_punctuation='after' for the dominant period/comma case; colon/semicolon exception cannot be represented.
Reference style is AMA Manual of Style, 11th Edition, with superscript arabic numerals ordered by citation.
Journal abbreviations follow the ISSN List of Title Word Abbreviations (LTWA); encoded journal_abbrev='nlm' as the abbreviated option.
Tables may be placed either in-text or grouped on separate page(s) at the end (guide permits either); encoded placement='in_text'.
Alignment: guide instructs 'do not use the word processor's options to justify text' — encoded alignment='left'.
scrub_metadata set true to reflect the double-anonymized review requirement to remove all identifying information; guide does not explicitly mention document file metadata.
Copyright is assigned to the Associação Brasileira de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação em Fisioterapia (ABRAPG-Ft); journal is hosted/published by Elsevier.
